marbles.help.goal.text: Place marbles on the triangle to score as many points as you can in {turns} turns. Each turn ends with a resolution, which produces an Impact. The Impact is added to your score.
marbles.help.goal.title: Goal of the game
marbles.help.hand.text: You draw {firstDraw} marbles on the first turn, then {draw, plural, one {# marble} other {# marbles}} each turn. Your hand holds {hand} marbles at most. Each placement is a throw, and you have {throws} throws per turn. Before any placement, you may swap two slots, once per turn.
marbles.help.hand.title: Hand, throws and draw
marbles.help.keys.title: Keys
marbles.help.keywords.text: A marble's effects trigger at specific moments: these are its keywords. On a marble, the E key reads its keywords, and Shift+E opens them in a menu. Control+Up and Control+Down browse its card.
marbles.help.keywords.title: Keywords
marbles.help.score.text: Marble effects change two counters: Speed, which starts at 0, and Mass, which starts at 1. At the end of the turn, the Impact is Speed times Mass. For this calculation, a negative Speed counts as 0, and a Mass below 1 counts as 1.
marbles.help.score.title: Score: Speed, Mass and Impact
marbles.help.title: Marbles help
marbles.help.triangle.text: The triangle has three slots: the left base, the right base and the apex. During the resolution, each slot plays its phase, in that order. Then the triangle turns one notch: the left base moves to the apex, the apex to the right base, and the right base to the left base.
marbles.help.triangle.title: The triangle and its rotation
marbles.help.wear.text: A marble on the triangle takes 1 wear at each phase. At its maximum wear, it leaves the triangle for the discard pile, and its Final effect triggers. Polish removes wear, Crack adds some.
marbles.help.wear.title: Wear
marbles.help.zones.text: The bag holds the marbles to draw. The discard pile receives those that leave the triangle; when the bag is empty, it is shuffled and becomes the bag. The pot keeps up to {pot} pocketed marbles, whose effects play for the whole game. A marble sent to a full pot is lost.
marbles.help.zones.title: The zones: bag, discard, pot, lost marbles
marbles.history.title: Turn {turn} history
marbles.keyword.apex.description: effect played during the apex phase, when the marble sits at the apex.
marbles.keyword.apex.name: Apex
marbles.keyword.awaken.description: triggers when the marble is drawn.
marbles.keyword.awaken.name: Awaken
marbles.keyword.base.description: effect played during the base phase, when the marble sits at the left or right base. It may differ by side.
marbles.keyword.base.name: Base
marbles.keyword.crack.description: adds wear to a marble. If it reaches its maximum, the marble is worn out and leaves the triangle at once.
marbles.keyword.crack.name: Crack
marbles.keyword.draw.description: draws marbles from the bag. If the bag is empty, the discard pile is shuffled to rebuild it.
marbles.keyword.draw.name: Draw
marbles.keyword.eject.description: knocks a marble off the triangle. It goes to the discard pile, and its knockout effect triggers.
marbles.keyword.eject.name: Eject
marbles.keyword.final.description: triggers when the marble is worn out and leaves the triangle. It is already in the discard by then: if its Final pockets it, it moves from the discard to the pot.
marbles.keyword.final.name: Final
marbles.keyword.flick.description: triggers when the marble is thrown from the hand, before it reaches the triangle.
marbles.keyword.flick.name: Flick
marbles.keyword.hit.description: triggers when the marble is placed on an occupied spot, after knocking out the marble that was there.
marbles.keyword.hit.name: Hit
marbles.keyword.knockout.description: triggers when the marble is knocked off the triangle by another marble.
marbles.keyword.knockout.name: Knockout
marbles.keyword.pocket.description: sends a marble to the pot, wherever it is: on the triangle, in hand or in the discard. If the pot is full, the marble is lost for the rest of the game.
marbles.keyword.pocket.name: Pocket
marbles.keyword.pocketed.description: effects active only while the marble is in the pot.
marbles.keyword.pocketed.name: Pocketed
marbles.keyword.polish.description: removes wear from a marble, so it stays longer on the triangle.
marbles.keyword.polish.name: Polish
marbles.keyword.title: Keywords of {marble}
marbles.keyword.windfall.description: triggers when the bag is rebuilt from the discard pile, if the marble is on the triangle.
marbles.keyword.windfall.name: Windfall
